defects.description: Section headers are not translated from English to Russian.
The translation changes the subject of the action: the operator is the one being asked to make a decision, but the Russian text suggests the operator is the one asking.
The glossary term 'Объект обсуждения' (Subject) is used to translate the phrase 'subject to', which is a linguistic error and a misuse of the glossary.
The glossary term 'Объект обсуждения' is replaced by the shortened lemma 'объект'.
The glossary term 'Уровень серьёзности' (Severity) is replaced by a different lemma 'степени серьёзности'.
